## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 1 сент. 2026 г. - 5 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _silna salim_, 5 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "The automatic renewal of my subscription has occurred, and I am currently unable to cancel it. This service does not align with my fitness preferences and has proven to be entirely unhelpful. A monthly payment has been automatically debited from my account. I cancelled your service within five minutes of the renewal. I require a full refund for this charge."
            2. _khaldonalsalami_, 1 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "useless just want to cancel subscription"
            3. _Akash Mishra_, 3 сент. 2026 г., 4/5: "However, the customer service and help desk experience has fallen short of the high standards set by the app itself. When encountering technical questions, subscription management concerns, or account-specific dashboard issues, getting a clear, timely, and effective resolution can be frustrating. Often, responses feel slow or lack the specific context needed to resolve account-related hurdles smoothly."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      6 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 23 мая 2026 г. - 3 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Jay Gardam_, 31 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "app keeps crashing. only started yesterday. paid and now can't get in."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 мая 2026 г., 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Kendall Buggs_, 2 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "Ridiculously glitchy app. Pointless"
<!--/ir-theme-->
